verdict.rationale: x402 exposes a documented HTTP-based protocol (402 flow, discovery APIs, facilitator endpoints) that AI agents can drive programmatically, with runtime probes confirming the discovery endpoint is live and keyless and the facilitator auth-gates as documented. However this is a payment/discovery protocol, not a general product API — there's no OpenAPI spec (probe-3 shows 404s across candidate paths), and full programmatic control (e.g., managing wallets, settlement, compliance rules) still routes through CDP SDKs rather than a single unified public API surface. missing for 10: a formal OpenAPI/swagger spec, independent hands-on confirmation of the full request/pay/retry loop beyond discovery, and evidence of broader API coverage beyond payments/discovery.
